lines.zh: 我在地下追，脚步砸得很重
lines.en: I hunt below ground, my steps crashing.

lines.zh: 每一步我都能翻过挡路的东西
lines.en: Every step I climb over whatever blocks me.

lines.zh: 我沿着洞穴的壁往上爬
lines.en: I climb the cave wall as I go.

lines.zh: 我不绕，我直接爬过去
lines.en: I do not go around; I climb over.

lines.zh: 石头在我脚下裂开
lines.en: Stone cracks under my feet.

lines.zh: 我的影子在洞壁上越来越近
lines.en: My shape grows nearer on the cave wall.

lines.zh: 我沿着洞壁走，脚掌抓得很牢。
lines.en: I keep to the cave wall, claws gripping tight.

lines.zh: 深一点的地方，才是我的地盘
lines.en: The deeper places are my ground.

lines.zh: 我闻得到你走进来的味道
lines.en: I can smell the way you came in.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸在洞穴里有回声
lines.en: My breathing echoes in the cave.

lines.zh: 我停下来听，你在跑
lines.en: I stop to listen; you are running.

lines.zh: 我一跳，抓着岩壁翻上去
lines.en: One leap, and I grip the rock to climb.

lines.zh: 我在暗处站着，等你转过来
lines.en: I stand in the dark, waiting for you to turn.

lines.zh: 我盯着那条通道，那是唯一的出口
lines.en: I stare at that passage; it is the only way out.

lines.zh: 这块宝石在我手里，凉得很
lines.en: The gem in my hand is cold.

lines.zh: 我不急，洞穴会把你留下
lines.en: I am in no hurry; the cave will keep you.

lines.zh: 我听见水滴声，也听见你的呼吸
lines.en: I hear dripping water, and also your breath.

lines.zh: 这里的每一条岔路我都走过
lines.en: I have walked every branch of this cave.

lines.zh: 我在等你爬到爬不动的地方
lines.en: I wait for the spot where you cannot climb.

lines.zh: 你拿走了我的东西
lines.en: You took what was mine.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛在暗处反光
lines.en: My eyes catch the dark and give it back.

lines.zh: 我抬手摸了一下洞壁，像在数路
lines.en: I touch the wall as if counting the route.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，正对着你
lines.en: I raise my head, squarely toward you.

lines.zh: 你手里的宝石，我认得
lines.en: The gem in your hand; I know it.

lines.zh: 你听见那句话了吗
lines.en: Did you read the message?

lines.zh: 我比你高，站在这里正好挡住路
lines.en: I am taller than you, and I block the way.

lines.zh: 你退到洞壁，那里没有岔路
lines.en: You back to the wall; there is no branch there.

lines.zh: 我不冲上来，我先看你怎么走
lines.en: I do not rush in; I watch how you move.

lines.zh: 这条通道很窄，只容一个
lines.en: This passage is narrow, only one abreast.

lines.zh: 你走得太深了
lines.en: You have come too deep.

lines.zh: 我的手指很长，能扣住石头
lines.en: My fingers are long; they can hold stone.

lines.zh: 你身上有矿灯的味道
lines.en: You smell of lamp oil.

lines.zh: 我在等你解释
lines.en: I am waiting for your explanation.

lines.zh: 你偷的不是石头
lines.en: What you stole is not a stone.

lines.zh: 我一步步走近，不急
lines.en: I close in step by step, unhurried.

lines.zh: 我退到洞壁边，重新攀住
lines.en: I retreat to the wall and regrip.

lines.zh: 这一下不轻，我记着
lines.en: That one counted; I remember.

lines.zh: 我低吼了一声，回声很长
lines.en: I growl once, and the echo is long.

lines.zh: 血滴在石头上，很响
lines.en: Blood dripping on stone is loud.

lines.zh: 我没有退远，只是换了个角度
lines.en: I have not gone far; only a new angle.

lines.zh: 我的手指在石上打滑
lines.en: My fingers slip on the rock.

lines.zh: 这点伤，换不回那块宝石
lines.en: That wound will not buy back the gem.

lines.zh: 我顶着痛继续爬
lines.en: I climb on through the pain.

lines.zh: 我在洞口方向站定
lines.en: I plant myself facing the entrance.

lines.zh: 你打了我，就应该跑
lines.en: You struck me; now you should run.

lines.zh: 把宝石放下，我可以不动手
lines.en: Set the gem down and I may not strike.

lines.zh: 你想拿东西引开我？没用
lines.en: You think an offering will distract me? No.

lines.zh: 我不吃，我只要我的东西
lines.en: I do not eat; I only want what is mine.

lines.zh: 你要是扔过来，我就接住
lines.en: Throw it over and I will catch it.

lines.zh: 这洞里没有食物，我知道
lines.en: There is no food in this cave; I know.

lines.zh: 你想用光引我？光只在入口
lines.en: You try to draw me with light? Light stays at the entrance.

lines.zh: 我看的是你的手，不是东西
lines.en: I watch your hands, not the object.

lines.zh: 你退一步，扔下东西，还能走
lines.en: Step back, drop it, and you may still leave.

lines.zh: 这块肉在洞穴里没有意义
lines.en: Meat means nothing down here.

lines.zh: 我不拿，我要你交出来
lines.en: I will not take it; I want you to hand it over.

lines.zh: 你一撞，我退了一步
lines.en: Your charge makes me give one step.

lines.zh: 我比你沉，撞不动
lines.en: I am heavier; you will not move me.

lines.zh: 我们撞上，岩壁掉下碎石
lines.en: We collide, and the wall sheds gravel.

lines.zh: 我抓住你的肩膀，很快松开
lines.en: I catch your shoulder, then let go.

lines.zh: 我撞开挡路的石堆
lines.en: I shove through a pile of rubble.

lines.zh: 你没有退路，身后是墙
lines.en: No way back for you; the wall is behind.

lines.zh: 我贴着岩壁挤过来，撞得你趔趄。
lines.en: Squeezing along the wall, I shove you off balance.

lines.zh: 我的爪子在地上刮出印子
lines.en: My claws leave marks on the floor.

lines.zh: 我半步没让
lines.en: I yield not half a step.

lines.zh: 你撞完就喘，我还没
lines.en: You are winded after the impact; I am not.

lines.zh: 洞穴深处的同伴，不需要说话
lines.en: Companions in the deep need no words.

lines.zh: 我们守着不同的岔路
lines.en: We keep different branches.

lines.zh: 我攀上去，你守下面
lines.en: I climb; you hold the floor.

lines.zh: 洞里的回声替我们传话
lines.en: The echoes carry for us.

lines.zh: 谁动了我的东西，我们一起去要
lines.en: Whoever took ours, we go take it back together.

lines.zh: 暗处是我的，亮处是你的
lines.en: The dark is mine, the light yours.

lines.zh: 我们不追出洞口，这是规矩
lines.en: We do not follow past the entrance; that is the rule.

lines.zh: 两双长手指扣在岩缝里
lines.en: Two sets of long fingers in the rock seams.

lines.zh: 洞壁上的两个影子并在一起
lines.en: Two shadows join on the cave wall.

lines.zh: 深处的黑暗容得下我们
lines.en: The deep dark has room for us.

lines.zh: 这块石头是凉的，不是我的那块
lines.en: This stone is cold, but it is not mine.

lines.zh: 我捡起来看了看，扔了
lines.en: I pick it up, look, and drop it.

lines.zh: 我把宝石按进掌心
lines.en: I press the gem into my palm.

lines.zh: 我的手指扣得太紧，它裂了
lines.en: My fingers clench too hard; it cracks.

lines.zh: 我拿东西的动作很慢
lines.en: My movements are slow when I take things.

lines.zh: 这东西在这里没用
lines.en: This is useless down here.

lines.zh: 我把它塞进洞壁的缝里
lines.en: I wedge it into a crack in the wall.

lines.zh: 掉在地上的，我一律不捡
lines.en: I never pick up what falls.

lines.zh: 我捡起来，是为了让你看着
lines.en: I pick it up so you have to watch.

lines.zh: 不属于我的，我不要
lines.en: What is not mine, I do not want.

lines.zh: 你拿了我的东西，我锁住你了
lines.en: You took what is mine; you are marked.

lines.zh: 洞穴里只有一条路，你会回来
lines.en: Only one path in this cave; you will come back.

lines.zh: 我闻到你手上的味道
lines.en: I smell it on your hands.

lines.zh: 我不从正面追，我爬上去截你
lines.en: I do not chase head-on; I climb to cut you off.

lines.zh: 这条通道往上走是死路
lines.en: This passage dead-ends upward.

lines.zh: 我的手指已经扣住岩石了
lines.en: My fingers have found the rock.

lines.zh: 你退，我就往前一步
lines.en: You retreat, I take one step.

lines.zh: 洞里这么黑，你跑不远的
lines.en: It is too dark; you will not get far.

lines.zh: 我记得你从哪个洞口进来的
lines.en: I remember which way you entered.

lines.zh: 你手里那点亮，恰好让我看清你
lines.en: That small light of yours shows me exactly where you are.

lines.zh: 我不喊，喊完你就跑得更快
lines.en: I do not shout; it would only make you run faster.

lines.zh: 我在你上方，你抬头也没用
lines.en: I am above you; looking up will not help.

lines.zh: 深洞是我的，路我比你熟
lines.en: The deep cave is mine, and I know the paths.

lines.zh: 你停下喘气的那一刻，我就到
lines.en: When you stop to breathe, I arrive.

lines.zh: 最后一口井，你会往下跳
lines.en: At the last shaft, you will jump down.

lines.zh: 我在井底等你
lines.en: I will be waiting at the bottom.

lines.zh: 我沿着洞壁跟着你，很稳
lines.en: I follow along the cave wall, steady.

lines.zh: 你走一段，我攀一段
lines.en: You walk a stretch; I climb a stretch.

lines.zh: 你在找出口，我不用找
lines.en: You are looking for the exit; I need none.

lines.zh: 洞顶低的地方，我弯着走
lines.en: Where the ceiling is low, I stoop.

lines.zh: 你摔的那一下，我听见了
lines.en: I heard you fall.

lines.zh: 我不急，这洞没有第二个出口
lines.en: I am patient; this cave has no second exit.

lines.zh: 你手电快没电了
lines.en: Your lamp is nearly out.

lines.zh: 石头挡路的，我直接翻上去
lines.en: I climb over any stone in the way.

lines.zh: 我攀着岩壁，一步一步压过来。
lines.en: I climb the rock face, closing in step by step.

lines.zh: 你在暗处看不见我，我看得见
lines.en: You cannot see me in the dark; I can see you.

lines.zh: 这条岔路我走过很多次
lines.en: I have taken this branch many times.

lines.zh: 你别往下跳，下面是空的
lines.en: Do not jump down; it is hollow below.

lines.zh: 我停在通道口，正好堵住
lines.en: I stop in the passage mouth and block it.

lines.zh: 你喘得厉害，我还能等
lines.en: You are gasping; I can still wait.

lines.zh: 岩壁上的抓痕是我留的
lines.en: The claw marks on the wall are mine.

lines.zh: 我用爪子在石上敲了三下
lines.en: I tap the stone three times with a claw.

lines.zh: 你回头，看见我贴着壁在爬
lines.en: You look back and see me crawling on the wall.

lines.zh: 深的地方我会更快
lines.en: I am faster deeper in.

lines.zh: 你走错了一个岔口
lines.en: You took the wrong branch.

lines.zh: 最后一段路，你只能往前
lines.en: The last stretch goes only forward.

lines.zh: 爪子从上方扫下来
lines.en: My claws sweep down from above.

lines.zh: 我一掌拍在岩壁上，碎石飞溅
lines.en: I slam the wall, and stone chips fly.

lines.zh: 这一抓带着整个身体的重量
lines.en: That rake carries my whole weight.

lines.zh: 我从洞顶落下来，砸在你旁边
lines.en: I drop from the ceiling beside you.

lines.zh: 你躲开了，我落地的声音很响
lines.en: You dodge; my landing booms.

lines.zh: 我推你一把，把你往回赶
lines.en: I shove you to drive you back.

lines.zh: 我的手指扣住你的手臂
lines.en: My fingers close on your arm.

lines.zh: 一拳打在石头上，石头碎了
lines.en: I punch stone, and the stone breaks.

lines.zh: 我要的不是你的命，是那块宝石
lines.en: I do not want your life; I want the gem.

lines.zh: 你退到边缘，站着别动
lines.en: You are at the edge; hold still.

lines.zh: 我出手很慢，可很重
lines.en: My strikes are slow, but heavy.

lines.zh: 洞穴把我的声音压得很低
lines.en: The cave flattens my voice low.

lines.zh: 我从洞顶落下，一把摁住你的背。
lines.en: I drop from the ceiling and pin your back.

lines.zh: 偷我宝石的人，我爬墙追。
lines.en: The gem thief I'll chase up walls.

lines.zh: 你把宝石扔下来，我就停
lines.en: Drop the gem and I stop.

lines.zh: 你还能爬，我很意外
lines.en: You can still climb; I am surprised.

lines.zh: 岩石碎在我脚边
lines.en: Rock crumbles at my feet.

lines.zh: 我从侧面扣住你，另一只手伸出来
lines.en: I pin you from the side and reach with the other hand.

lines.zh: 洞里没有东西可以躲
lines.en: There is nowhere to hide in this cave.

lines.zh: 你的灯灭了，现在都归我
lines.en: Your lamp is out; now all of it is mine.

lines.zh: 洞里传来抓挠岩石的声音
lines.en: The sound of claws on rock comes through the cave.

lines.zh: 我是在你拿走宝石之后来的
lines.en: I came after you took the gem.

lines.zh: 那句话你先看到了
lines.en: You read the message first.

lines.zh: 洞口的风停了，我进来了
lines.en: The draft at the entrance stops; I have come in.

lines.zh: 我从上一个矿洞的岔口爬进来
lines.en: I crawl in from the branch above.

lines.zh: 这洞里的黑暗，正合我意
lines.en: The dark of this cave suits me.

lines.zh: 我的影子先落到你脚边
lines.en: My shadow reaches your feet first.

lines.zh: 我没有脚步，只有扣石的声音
lines.en: I make no footsteps, only the click of gripping stone.

lines.zh: 你听见远处的拖拽声了吗
lines.en: Did you hear that dragging sound far off?

lines.zh: 我挑了一条你没注意的路
lines.en: I chose a path you did not notice.

lines.zh: 洞壁上多了一道人形的影子
lines.en: A human-shaped shadow joins the cave wall.

lines.zh: 我来的时候没打算走
lines.en: I did not plan to leave when I came.

lines.zh: 深洞里的空气变了
lines.en: The air in the deep cave has changed.

lines.zh: 我停在通道口，把路堵住
lines.en: I stop in the passage mouth and seal it.

lines.zh: 火把的味道让我退到石后
lines.en: The torch smell drives me behind the rock.

lines.zh: 我摔下几格，岩壁刮破了皮
lines.en: I drop several blocks; the wall scrapes me raw.

lines.zh: 地下水灌进嘴里，我猛往上游
lines.en: Groundwater pours in; I kick hard for the surface.

lines.zh: 炸开的气浪把碎石全推向我
lines.en: The blast hurls all the rubble into me.

lines.zh: 一支箭扎进肩膀，我继续爬
lines.en: An arrow scores my shoulder; I keep climbing.

lines.zh: 一股光缠住我的手指
lines.en: A light coils around my fingers.

lines.zh: 洞里没什么可吃，我也不在意
lines.en: There is little to eat here, and I do not care.

lines.zh: 雷声顺着矿洞传下来，我伏低
lines.en: Thunder rolls down the mine; I flatten.

lines.zh: 井底没有了，我一直在掉
lines.en: The shaft bottom is gone; I keep falling.
